certification_boundary: This immutable calibration receipt records two retained 25-seat workshops, the reclaimed failed Serve LLMs attempt, and the model-capacity experiment as observed before Arena API connectivity returned. It does not certify the exact retained three-workshop event topology.

serve-llms-red-attempt.failure: Three Showroom pods assigned to rhgnr1 remained PodInitializing beyond the collective readiness window during sustained staggered startup.

rhgnr1_reliability.conclusion: Idle and small-burst health did not predict sustained startup behavior; keep the worker cordoned until runtime and network repair is independently certified.

rejected_48_96.reason: Correctness passed but participant latency regressed and the unequal request/limit lost Guaranteed QoS.

proposed_80_80.reason: The manifest contract was GREEN locally, but the Arena API became unreachable before live deployment and re-certification.

blocking_gate.observed_error: Arena API and worker addresses became unreachable during the 80/96 measurement stream.
blocking_gate.required_next_proof: Restore Arena access, deploy 80/80, prove Guaranteed QoS and 25-seat Agent 201 latency, then provision and functionally certify the retained Serve LLMs workshop.

proof_strategy.TDD: The Arena target pin, explicit certification kubeconfig wrapper, model resources, and this evidence schema each began with a failing test.
proof_strategy.EDD: Workshop identifiers, lifecycle timing, functional outcomes, capacity decisions, node behavior, and cleanup residue are recorded without credentials.
proof_strategy.CDD: Catalog, placement, model resource, participant probe, and evidence contracts remain versioned in Git.
proof_strategy.BDD: Given two retained green workshops and a third staggered order, the event remains RED until all 75 seats are simultaneously ready and participant journeys pass.
proof_strategy.CBT: Node health, model readiness, model QoS, capacity preview, per-seat workflow, authorization, and cleanup were evaluated as separate components.
